post_collection_census.qualification: Actual file-length sum, not content-hash deduplication or filesystem metadata/physical write amplification. Conservative ownership includes intermediates/stages and overcounts shared or collected storage; it is separate from active candidate admission and actual bytes. Preparing reservation used=0 does not mean zero physical writes: its full allowance remains charged until sealed transfer or fenced deletion.
